reviews.x: Loved how many came in a pack since I ALWAYS lose my hair ties. They’re really stretchy and can hold a lot of hair. I have my hair in box braids now and with just 1 it held all of my hair back for work. My natural hair also doesn’t get tangled in them which is why I originally bought them. I love the packaging and super satisfied with the product over all.

Originally, I was slightly bummed opening this up as I had gold and silver pieces and this is an all black hair tie purchase. HOWEVER, I received my whole 90 pieces of black hair ties (technically 91) plus an additional 5 gold and 5 silver. Package was pretty cute too. As far as quality, these are similar to any other hair ties like this. Good quality.

reviews.t: Nice product, but not accurate advertising
reviews.x: The elastic hair ties arrived fairly quickly and are a nice size. The only reason I am not giving this 5 stars is that the description says you are getting 100 black hair ties and the sticker on the package you receive says the contents are black hair ties. What I found inside the package was not strictly black hair ties. There are 10 sparkly silver and 10 sparkly gold hair ties. I now have 20 less hair ties that I can use since I needed black. So, inaccurate advertising earns 4 stars.

reviews.t: I use these on my hair because they don't pull ...
reviews.x: I use these on my hair because they don't pull or tangle but I bought the pack of 100 for organizing my closet! I rolled my leggings and put a hair tie around each one to save space and prevent refolding when I dig around to find a specific pair!

Wow - this is a bargain and a find. I’ve been looking for these fabric ponytail binders at all the regular for some time. I’ve found different colored ones, but not black. These work perfectly and are WAY CHEAPER than the ones on stores.
I'm using these to make fabric masks. I untie them, and add one at each corner. Each mask uses 4. Person knots two behind their head and two behind their neck. They work great!!!!!

These are the best hair ties! Never going back to any other kind. They don't wank my hair out and they stay in all day without give. I have thin fine hair and hair ties tend to slip out but not these! Worth the money!
They are fabulous for the ‘ouchless’ factor. I was disappointed that my package of black included silver and gold which I was unable to use for  my application.
Horrible product.  Loosens every time you wear it.  Does not hold hair in place!!!

I wear my hair up in a ponytail every day at work, and I love these bands. I’ve bought a few other brands in the past, and they were good… but 100 for the price, I thought something must be wrong with them. Nope! They are just like all of the others and you get a huge quantity, totally great value! They say there are for men but of course, they are gender neutral, and as a woman I am so thankful for this purchase! It should last me quite a long time!

reviews.t: Too Much Black Dye: Gets on EVERYTHING!
reviews.x: I bought these to use on my daughters hair. If you use products the dye from these get all over the sheets and pillowcases. It’s so gross. I’ve washed the hair ties over 4 times and black dye is still coming out. So, if the dye gets on things… It’s bleeding onto the hair. No good.
These don't stretch as much as I thought they would, and the stretch out quickly. Good for low ponytail days, but that's pretty much it. They don't hold my thick hair in a bun or higher ponytail.
First off I have to admit I didn’t buy these for my hair, I bought them to use as elastic on face masks I was making. They worked perfect, although wider they are very soft around the ear.

reviews.t: Arrived with a mixture of black, silver, and gold.
reviews.x: For some reason these came with some silver, gold,  and black ones also. If you like glitter, you will be in luck. Otherwise you are getting only 1/2of the black ones.
These were supposed to be all black. I received some ugly gold and silver glitter instead of black. I'll choose a different supplier.
Literally no stretch and caused so much breakage to my hair. Not worth the money even if you get a huge amount.
They come in 100 pack because they only last 1 time but not bad for the price
Not enough stretch. Thought they would have a satin feel.  Expensive
Not ideal for thick hair, they don’t stretch well
These are really stretched out super fast.

reviews.t: A bag full of headbands...as advertised
reviews.x: I had no idea what I was doing to my mane until a thoughtful hair stylist told me to wean myself from my trusty Goody bands.  She said they were creasing my hair because the elastic was so tight, well I kinda figured that was the point of a hairband but I'm a dude and when she said it was breaking my hair and making it fall out I perked up.  I typically don't even use hairbands except when I'm riding my motorcycle or working on my car..sometimes when I cook that's always a good time to keep hair

reviews.t: Decent Hairties for someone who loses them all
reviews.x: I am an extremely forgetful person and I shed more hair ties than I do hair. I'll buy a 10 or 20 pack and they only last me a month because I just leave them everywhere or they magically disappear into the ether. So, to try to make my life easier and save money, I thought these soft no-tug hair ties in a huge quantity would be a decent idea.  At first I hated them. I thought they were really loose, hard to cinch up good, and slipped off my hair easily, but after a week or so of learning how to u

I love these so much better than the traditional elastic hair ties and I don’t think I’ll ever go back! They stretch well enough for their size and they stay in place! Taking them out is super easy too. I haven’t had any hair get tangled in them! I like that they come in brown as well! Also the pack of 40 is plenty! I recommend hand washing them before use as with anything else you plan to use on your body. I ordered these with some twist hair bands and washed them together and the water turned

Way too sparkly for me.  I assumed what I was seeing in the picture was more of a heather look (like in t shirts or whatever when it has speckles of gray) but this is sparkles.  I think part of the reason I assumed that was because it is marketed to guys.  But that is just to sell them to guys.  As others have said, the packaging it comes in is clearly for women.  Mine said “ribbon hair ties for beautiful women” on the packaging.  Not worth returning, I will just keep them and use them until I l

I put my hair up in a bun w 1 of these & 8.5 hours later & it was still up and hadn’t moved an inch! Even traditional hair bands didn’t do that with my hair! I am sold. I’d buy more but I think 100 will last me a lonnnng time! 🤣  They are also a great value for your money because some (like Goodie) can cost the same for about 10 & they stretch out w no way to tighten. With these, you can untie & retie shorter if you want to. 😉

claims.text: Many reviewers find these hair ties strong, stretchy, and effective at holding hair without tangling or pulling.
Several reviewers praise the value and large quantity for the price.
Multiple reviewers report receiving gold and silver ties mixed in with the black ones, contrary to the all-black description.
Some reviewers say the ties stretch out quickly and don't hold thick hair well.
One reviewer reports black dye bleeding onto sheets and hair even after repeated washing.
